purpose: Opcode-level Cortex-M4 source-to-predicted-assembly timing evidence. This is a zero-wait-state core model, not a complete S32K148 execution-time guarantee.

notes: TRM Table 3-1 cycle counts assume a zero-wait-state system.
Exact S32K148 PFlash, cache, prefetch, speculation, crossbar and peripheral wait states are not included.
Instruction overlap and load/store pipelining mean that summing isolated instruction latency is an engineering approximation, not a cycle-accurate pipeline simulation.

N.meaning: number of registers transferred, including PC or LR when present

B.policy: Unresolved unless the memory-system state is supplied.

W.meaning: cycles waiting for an event or interrupt

applies_to: IT when folded onto a preceding 16-bit Thumb instruction

document_cycle_value_inventory.footnote: Neighboring single load/store address and data phases can pipeline; Section 3.3.2 contains sequence-level exceptions.

document_cycle_value_inventory.note: Table 3-1 notation is preserved; Section 3.3.2 also gives blocking-operation guidance for these forms.

document_cycle_value_inventory.meaning: The table does not state an ordinary fixed execution-cycle value.

instruction_classes.name: multiply
instruction_classes.compatibility_role: MUL and one-cycle multiply/DSP aggregate only; MLA and MLS are two cycles

instruction_classes.name: sram_or_stack_load
instruction_classes.compatibility_role: isolated single-transfer TRM table cost before sequence-level pipelining

instruction_classes.name: sram_or_stack_store
instruction_classes.compatibility_role: isolated single-transfer TRM table cost; immediate-offset STR can be effectively one cycle under the TRM pipeline rule

instruction_classes.name: function_return_with_refill
instruction_classes.compatibility_role: BX LR modeled as 1+P with P=3

notes: Early termination depends on leading ones and zeroes in the operands.

opcode_timing_groups.sequence_effect: Neighboring single loads/stores can pipeline address and data phases and may complete at one instruction per execution cycle.

opcode_timing_groups.load_store_section_guidance: Section 3.3.2 describes LDR PC as at least five cycles with a three-cycle refill, or more when load/fetch stalls. Preserve both the table formula and this sequence-level guidance rather than silently choosing the optimistic minimum.

opcode_timing_groups.sequence_effect: Neighboring single loads/stores can pipeline address and data phases.

special_case.condition: address generation and buffered data store overlap the following instruction; stalls can still occur when the store buffer or target bus cannot accept the transfer

records.load_store_section_guidance: Section 3.3.2 decomposes the operation into load, add and three-cycle refill and describes at least six cycles, or more if load/fetch stalls.

opcode_timing_groups.fold_condition: May fold onto a preceding 16-bit Thumb instruction.

records.policy: Exception/debug behavior must be modeled separately; do not invent a normal instruction cost.

notes: Cortex-M4 TRM Table 3-2 lists the implemented DSP instruction set at one cycle.

floating_point_policy.reason: The cited Cortex-M4 core Table 3-1 and DSP Table 3-2 do not provide a complete context-independent FPU cycle table. Do not map FPU operations to the integer one-cycle class or invent costs.
floating_point_policy.required_action: Return unresolved unless an authoritative Cortex-M4F FPU timing profile and the S32K148 FPU configuration are supplied.

load_store_pipeline_rules: Neighboring single load/store instructions can pipeline address and data phases, allowing one instruction per execution cycle in qualifying sequences.
STR Rt,[Rn,#imm] is described as one cycle because address generation and the data store overlap the following instruction.
A full or disabled store buffer, a non-bufferable target, bus stalls, unaligned accesses, bit-band accesses and memory-region boundaries can add delay.
LDR to PC is blocking and additionally incurs pipeline refill P.
Sequence-level effects must be modeled from instruction order; they cannot be recovered from an unordered aggregate ledger.
multi_register_rule: For PUSH, POP, LDM, STM, LDRD, or STRD use the exact TRM formula and count N from the actual register list. POP/LDM including PC additionally incurs P.
pipeline_refill_rule: P ranges from 1 to 3. Legacy aggregate classes use conservative P=3; opcode-level estimates should retain the range unless target alignment, instruction width and speculation prove a specific value.
unaligned_access_policy: Not included in the zero-wait-state aligned base cost. Treat any unaligned or cross-region access as unresolved unless its exact transfer behavior is supplied.
pflash_policy: S32K148 PFlash/cache/prefetch/speculation costs are outside the Cortex-M4 core table. Do not invent a fixed wait-state count or correction multiplier. Use a separate, configuration-specific NXP memory-system profile.
unknown_opcode_policy: An opcode or form absent from this profile is unresolved. Never silently map it to alu_move_compare_shift.

coverage.arm_ddi_0439b_table_3_1: covered at opcode-family and exceptional-form level
coverage.arm_ddi_0439b_table_3_2: covered; all listed DSP operations are one-cycle records
coverage.section_3_3_2_sequence_effects: represented as conditional sequence rules, not collapsed into fixed per-opcode costs
coverage.cortex_m4f_fpu: explicitly unresolved because the cited core/DSP timing tables do not provide a complete context-independent FPU timing table
coverage.s32k148_memory_system: explicitly external to this core profile and requires a board-configuration-specific profile
